name: Sika Set Accelerator
paste:
SIKA® SET ACCELERATOR: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Set Accelerator, April 2023, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sika_set_accelerator.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Set Accelerator where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Set Accelerator is a calcium-chloride based admixture used to reduce the setting time of concrete.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Set Accelerator can be used to reduce concrete setting times and improve early strength development and is useful in the following applications:
    - Reduction of setting time during cold-weather concrete work.
    - Emergency concrete repairs where early strength is necessary.
    - Improve setting time and early strength for fast-track construction.
    - Improve setting time and early strength for precast concrete products.
    Note: The use of Sika® Set Accelerator will increase the calcium-chloride content of concrete. Precautions must be taken to ensure the chloride content of reinforced or prestressed concrete does not exceed the chloride limits imposed by AS 1379 and other relevant construction standards.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Set Accelerator
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Ac – Set Accelerator
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Sika® Set Accelerator meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 Set-accelerating Admixture (Ac)
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS 1379: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where: Uses (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. The advantages of Sika® Set Accelerator are:
    - Reduced initial setting time of concrete.
    - Improved early strength development of concrete.
    - Reduction of delays due to cold weather.
    - Reduction of concrete bleed (due to faster set)
    - Earlier stripping times.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Liquid solution of calcium chloride
    - Appearance and colour: Clear to cloudy liquid.
    - Specific gravity: 1.33 g/cm³
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Total chloride ion content: 1000 ml contains approx. 330 g chloride ion.
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 205 litre drum; 10 litre container
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperatures between 5°C and 35° C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight, shelf life is at least one (1) year.
    - Storage conditions: Store at temperature between 5°C and 35°C, protected from the direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Compatibility: When using with other admixtures check compatibility first. When using Sika® Set Accelerator laboratory and site trials are recommended.
4.3 Recommended dosage. Typical dosage is between 1000 and 2000 ml per 100 kg of total cementitious material. Optimum dosage should be determined by site trials. Dosages outside the typical range can be used. Trials should be carried out to confirm performance. As ambient and concrete temperatures reduce an increase in the dose rate of Sika® Set Accelerator may be necessary in order to maintain performance. At very low temperatures (typically below 5°C), other precautions may be necessary in order to ensure concrete sets. Precautions may include heating water or aggregates etc.
4.4 Dispensing. Sika® Set Accelerator should ideally be dispensed with the batch water. Sika® Set Accelerator should not be dispensed directly onto dry cementitious materials. Sika® Set Accelerator can be added to concrete after mixing, but concrete should then be thoroughly mixed before being discharged. (Minimum of 1 minute/m³ mixing at full speed).
4.5 Limitations and important considerations. When used in the typical dose range the chloride content may exceed the chloride limits allowed in the Australian Standards for reinforced or prestressed concrete. Sika’s chloride-free accelerators should be considered for use in these cases.
4.6 Further information.
    - Sika® Set Accelerator can significantly reduce concrete setting times. Long haulage distances/times, increased temperatures and high dose rates will significantly increase the risk of concrete setting during transit.
    - For additional information, please contact your local Sika Representative.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.03) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Set Accelerator, April 2023, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sika_set_accelerator.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® Set Accelerator, version 07/10/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/MSDS%20Sika%20Set%20Accelerator%20GHS7.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD Sika® Set Accelerator, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/q/epd-sika-set-accelerator.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
